observations: Commit f0a71760 (2 Sep 2026, 16:30) moved applications/ to docs/applications/; at AAS's direction it was moved back to the repository root at 17:05 the same day. Spec 0.3c, the implementation map and the task files name every application path from the repository root as applications/…; the six per-application tests, packages/sym/tests/test_corpus.py, and the docs/notebooks symlink resolve the root at the pre-f0a71760 depth. File digests are unchanged by the move.
The acceptance notebook is also reachable through the symlink docs/notebooks/solve_port_cons_ffp.ipynb -> ../../applications/cons-port/notebooks/port-cons/solve_port_cons_ffp.ipynb.
N01's overlay must reproduce applications/cons-port/… under overlay/; the notebook's ../../code and ../../syntax references resolve unchanged inside applications/cons-port/.
The full parser suite from the new root: venv/bin/python -m pytest packages/sym/tests docs/applications -q reported 47 passed, 6 skipped, 1 xfailed on 2 Sep 2026 (16:38).

Cell ids are recorded as stored in each file (raw JSON), not as nbformat reports them: nbformat.read assigns a random id to every id-less cell of a format-4.5 notebook, which made the first record's ids for such cells unstable (corrected 2 Sep, 17:55). Notebooks with id-less cells, whose P02 provenance must key those cells by index: applications/cons-port/notebooks/port-cons/solve_port_cons_ffp.ipynb (12 of 55 cells); applications/stage-pipeline-demos/spec_0.1c_demo.ipynb (26 of 26 cells); applications/stage-pipeline-demos/durables/tenure_tag_verification.ipynb (2 of 2 cells); applications/stage-pipeline-demos/stage_pipeline.ipynb (22 of 22 cells).

2026-09-05: task P04 merged the bellman-sym and bellman-cat distributions into one distribution named bellman, a regular package at packages/bellman/bellman/ with the subpackages sym and cat. packages/sym/bellman/sym/ is now packages/bellman/bellman/sym/, packages/cat/bellman/cat/ is packages/bellman/bellman/cat/, packages/sym/tests/ is packages/bellman/tests/sym/, packages/cat/tests/ is packages/bellman/tests/cat/, packages/sym/harness/ is packages/bellman/harness/, and packages/cat/notebooks/ is packages/bellman/notebooks/; module import paths (bellman.sym.…, bellman.cat.…) are unchanged. The nineteen task_paths entries under the two old directories were re-pointed in place (the two directory entries packages/sym and packages/cat became the one entry packages/bellman, so counts['existing directory'] fell from 13 to 12 and the entry total from 185 to 184); their classifications are those recorded on 2 Sep 2026 and were not re-checked. The quoted D01 ruling, the note on legacy dolo paths, and the earlier observations keep the paths as they stood on 2 Sep 2026.
